name: LLM portfolio (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
description: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5, the current dateless Sonnet id, which Anthropic documents as a fixed snapshot) allocates the nine Select Sector SPDR ETFs once per US session before the open. Each decision reads only a table computed from prices through the decision close (1/5/21/63-session returns, 21/63-session volatility, distance to the 50/200-session averages, current weights) and answers through a fixed tool schema with one weight per ETF plus cash; invalid output is retried once. The prompt template's SHA-256 and the input table's SHA-256 are stored in every entry, with the full response and token usage. Published token prices are $2/$10 per million input/output; the declared worst case is two attempts at 20k input and 4,096 output tokens ($0.17). Monthly cap $15, forward only: no historical run is possible or permitted.
